title: Vikings at 49ers is listed at Estadio Banorte, Mexico City
detail: The official game centre lists the venue as Estadio Banorte, Mexico City. Do not read a home-field flag from the team order on the schedule for this fixture.

title: Only 13 of 272 fixtures are transcribed
detail: This register covers the Week 11 slate only. The other 259 fixtures stay unverified until each game-centre page is read.

title: Kickoff times are Eastern as printed; no UTC conversion is published here
detail: The official schedule page prints Eastern times. Converting them is left to the consumer; no offset is assumed.

title: Two committed copies of the 2026 roster disagree
detail: data/raw/roster_2026.csv has 3,073 data rows and 408 reserve rows. data/raw/roster_2026.csv.gz has 3,070 rows and 383 reserve rows. Origination committed artifacts show 400 reserve rows. The origination loader reads the plain CSV. Which copy is canonical is not established; neither was rebuilt here.
source_label: Repository manifest (data/raw; the roster is a community release)

title: Origination determinism check fails in this sandbox and on a clean checkout
detail: origination/scripts/verify.py fails on determinism for 8 tracked files and leaves 9 modified files. The recorded community schedule digest is sha256:57c2f1b0…; the fetched digest is sha256:3f71bc90…. The mismatch adds an extra snapshot. The same step passes in CI on e8877e0, so the cause of the difference is not established. Nothing was rebuilt or committed.

title: Readiness P1 odds-row count changed from 163 to 162 on rebuild
detail: Rebuilding readiness from the refreshed upstream games file gives 162; the committed page showed 163. P1 is not a row this session claims, so the change is flagged, not accepted silently.

title: Lions Week 10 status: Joseph, Mays and Reed corrected to Out
detail: The dashboard had no game status for Kerby Joseph (S, knee), Cade Mays (C, ankle) or D.J. Reed (CB, hip). The official Week 10 article lists all three as OUT. Joseph's practice status changes from Limited to Did Not Participate. Corrected on 2026-11-16.

title: Dashboard build reports SEA, CIN, LAC and BAL with no injury rows
detail: The dashboard Week 10 build found no rows for these four clubs. Whether their official reports list players was not checked in this session; the item stays open for the injury-capture owner.
